sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Icosapent ethyl (ethyl eicosapentaenoate) is a prodrug of eicosapentaenoate (EPA), which is the active component. Although no information is available on the clinical use of icosapent ethyl during breastfeeding, considerable information is available on the use of EPA during breastfeeding (See Marine Oils for further information). If a mother requires icosapent ethyl, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding.
